Package com.vectorpeaks.backend.controller

Class BookingController

java.lang.Object
com.vectorpeaks.backend.controller.BookingController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/bookings") @CrossOrigin(origins="*") public class BookingController extends Object
Controller for managing bookings (lesson reservations). Provides endpoints to create bookings and retrieve bookings for a specific student. Includes built-in BOLA (Broken Object Level Authorization) protection and security event logging.
Version:
1.4
Author:
EduLink Team

      @PutMapping("/{bookingId}/status") @PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> updateBookingStatus(@PathVariable Integer bookingId, @RequestParam String status, org.springframework.security.core.Authentication authentication)
      Updates the status of a booking.
      Parameters:
      bookingId - the ID of the booking
      status - new status string (ACCEPTED, REJECTED, or COMPLETED)
